item.title: Deep-level engineering in aluminum nitride (AlN) enables reliable photodetection in extreme conditions
item.description: arXiv:2606.07807v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Semiconductor photodetectors are conventionally optimized for sensing weak optical signals, and they typically saturate at low-to-moderate light intensity. Here, we demonstrate AlN photodetectors that exhibit non-saturating linear response to ultra-bright, sub-bandgap light exceeding 40 $\mathrm{W/cm^2}$ (over 400 Suns). The photodetector further shows undistorted linear response at elevated temperature, up to at least 300 $\mathrm{^\circ C}$.
